body.focus: Bug: insrc_present (and the pending-list machinery behind it) fails to re-open an already-written, approved brainstorm SPEC artifact. `deriveMdPath` in src/workflow/pending.ts (line ~249) resolves a SPEC artifact's markdown path by checking `meta['standalone'] === true`, defaulting to the 'epic' work-item kind when that flag is absent/false — producing `docs/epics/<slug>/SPEC.md`. But a brainstorm SPEC artifact is ALWAYS written under `docs/standalone/<slug>/SPEC.md` regardless of the standalone meta flag, per the write-side special case in `pathsForWorkflow` (src/workflow/storage.ts ~line 1177-1188, workflow === 'brainstorm' always resolves 'standalone' and never stamps meta.standalone=true back). Fix: add an early special-case inside `deriveMdPath` (src/workflow/pending.ts) so that `kind === 'SPEC'` always resolves `workItemKind = 'standalone'`, mirroring the write-side special case already proven correct in `pathsForWorkflow` — rather than falling through to the generic `meta['standalone'] === true` check that SPEC artifacts never satisfy. No change to the write path, the SpecArtifact schema, or any other artifact kind's path resolution. See ISSUE-778fc07c9d84c7fb for the full reproduction/root-cause record.
body.summary: Fixed deriveMdPath (src/workflow/pending.ts) to special-case kind==='SPEC' as always-standalone, matching the write-side logic in storage.ts's pathsForWorkflow brainstorm branch, so insrc_present/pending-list resolution reads the SPEC.md file at its real docs/standalone/ path instead of a nonexistent docs/epics/ path. Added a regression test in pending.test.ts.
